Perhaps I can save LSJ some time by posting his response to the Giant's
Blood issue here.
>> 1. If i play a Giant's Blood and my prey plays Sudden Reversal,
>> can i play another GB late?
>No. Canceling the card's effect doesn't mean the card wasn't played.

Meaning that cards like Giant's blood do not care what happens after
the card is played. Once they are played, the game remembers that it
was played (note that burned or discarded cards are not played and do
not trigger the only one clause).

If Ancient Influence were written "Only on AI may be called in a game",
then you would actually have to call the vote before the clause kicks
in. However, as it is written, playing the card immediately triggers
the clause and ignores what ever happens after that - DI, Delaying
Tactics [my personal favorite response to AI and Political
Stranglehold].

Stu
-Your Friendly Neighborhood Camarilla Scholar

Greetings, noble childe of Caine.

I can see from your perusal of my tome that you have accepted my gift.
I do apologize for sending this volume directly to your haven,
but it seemed to be the most efficient means of gaining your attention.
Perhaps that is the best reason for you to listen.
I applaud you for setting aside your pride
and rading my little...story.

As you well know, the Jyhad is the struggle against the eldest of
Caine`s children,
the Ancient Ones who seek to control our society through subtle
manipulation
and display of raw power.

I have a role in the struggle as well. I carefully select ancillae and
elders
for their potential to survive the machinations of their peers,
as well as their abillity to overcome challenges that would destroy
most of their kind. In essence, these chosen ones are the true elite
among the
night stalkers. You are among that elite.

The Tremere Chantry invites you to come to Vienna and take part in the
biggest
struggle of Vampires ever:

The Vampire The Eternal Struggle European Championships

All the information you will need can be found on the following page

http://www.angelfire.com/on3/vtes

Yet if you heed my words, you may yet win yourself hope! Look well
into this Pandora`s box, and you may yet find that which you seek.

Alexander Woisetschläger
